automated_baseline.limits: Initial page states in disposable app HTTP fixture. Does not prove every dialog, failure state, role or external provider operation is complete.

flow_review.head: 83c8057
flow_review.method: Read-only source and assertion audit; no application code modified and no test execution claimed. Status verified_code_path means directly supported by implementation; races still need deterministic runtime reproduction. Forbidden security report never opened.

findings.title: Non-admin users cannot reach their own password or MFA settings
evidence: console/kf_console.py:3004 (hidden navigation is rejected, including direct #team)
console/kf_console.py:2944 (personal security and password controls are inside team)
console/kf_console.py:233 (password/MFA self-service is authorized for every login)
findings.impact: Ops and finance cannot change their password, enroll MFA or regenerate recovery codes using the console. This also blocks completing step-up protected DNS/domain actions when MFA has not yet been enrolled.
findings.recommendation: Expose a personal account/security destination for every role; keep user administration and role/audit controls admin-only.
findings.coverage: tests/ui/real-api.test.cjs:38 exercises role API denial and :48 pre-enrolled MFA login, but neither exercises ops/finance self-service enrollment or password changes.

findings.title: Operations users see maintenance controls but forbidden reads render as successful completion
evidence: console/kf_console.py:3293 (pollUpdates parses error JSON without r.ok)
console/kf_console.py:3310 (SMTP error JSON becomes default blank configuration)
findings.impact: An ordinary ops visit to Maintenance presents an empty configuration, no-checks state and Completed despite both reads being forbidden. Buttons then fail on mutation rather than explaining permissions.
findings.recommendation: Gate destination/actions using explicit capabilities and fail reads visibly before rendering data; Completed must require a successful terminal operation state.
findings.coverage: tests/ui/readability.test.cjs:21 uses admin for all-page sweeps; tests/ui/real-api.test.cjs:38 does not navigate Maintenance as ops. No test of maintenance 403/500/offline state found.

findings.title: Preview shares can display one site’s links under another site’s selection
evidence: console/kf_console.py:3398 (loadShares has no request epoch or selected-slug check)
console/kf_console.py:3402 (every completed request renders to sList)
console/kf_console.py:3438 (site changes start independent loadShares requests)
findings.impact: If A responds after B when switching sites, A links and revoke buttons are shown while the selector says B. Revocation uses the displayed token, so operators may revoke the wrong customer review link.
findings.recommendation: Clear or mark old data loading, cancel/ignore stale responses using the requested site, and bind visible target identity to each mutating action.
findings.coverage: No share creation/revocation/cross-site latency E2E journey found in tests/ui. security.test.cjs:25 visits a seeded shared preview for content safety only.

findings.title: Preview sharing treats authorization/server errors as an empty list
evidence: console/kf_console.py:3439 (create lacks pending guard and empty-site guard)
findings.impact: Expired sessions or HTTP failures claim that there are no review links and invite another write; repeated Create clicks are not disabled while a request is pending.
findings.recommendation: Use a shared loading/error/empty state with retry and login recovery; disable creation without an eligible site and while submitting.
findings.coverage: No failed-share read or repeated-create tests found; overall page layout and English scans do not validate the semantics.

findings.title: Plan editing is presented to roles that cannot save plans
evidence: console/kf_console.py:2993 (plans remains visible for all three roles)
findings.impact: Finance and ops can enter changes into a usable-looking plan editor only to be rejected on save. The screen does not distinguish read-only catalog access from management.
findings.recommendation: Return plan-management capability and render catalog read-only for unauthorized roles, with a clear explanation.
findings.coverage: No plan-save role journey found in tests/ui; the per-role test verifies users/audit/spec endpoints only.

findings.title: Site identity is local to pages and is not part of routes or the overview handoff
evidence: console/kf_console.py:3067 (overview actions have no Open site workspace / edit / DNS handoff)
findings.impact: A copied #layout or #dns URL resolves using the receiver’s prior site context, and overview inspection does not establish the next task’s site. This is a product coherence gap for a Cloudflare-style per-site console, not a demonstrated data leak.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit account versus site navigation and a persistent site header; deep-link to route plus site and add contextual overview-to-editor/DNS/operations actions.
findings.coverage: tests/ui/admin-experience.test.cjs:34 covers one selected demo site propagating from Leads to Clients. Missing two-site deep links, refresh/back-forward and overview-to-site journeys.

coverage_by_navigation_page.sites: Search/filter/archive and responsive sweep; missing overview-to-site operational journey and zero-site first-run onboarding.
coverage_by_navigation_page.automation: Mock prepared action execution plus real operations-inbox routing; no real provider end-to-end operational workflow proof.
coverage_by_navigation_page.domain: Real local credential/metadata CRUD and safeguards; no registrar-to-DNS-to-HTTPS end-to-end proof.
coverage_by_navigation_page.dns: Real local zone CRUD with review and MFA rejection; upstream authority/query are fixture functions.
coverage_by_navigation_page.maint: Layout/English sweep; no operational update success/failure, pending, role denial or SMTP journey.
coverage_by_navigation_page.ai: Existing-site staged generation and stale prompt review; new-site first-step validation only in builder-workflow.
coverage_by_navigation_page.layout: Draft CRUD/save/reload/preview/deletion/recovery tests exist; actual WordPress transport substituted.
coverage_by_navigation_page.design: Saved recipe CRUD/apply review/dirty safeguards exist.
coverage_by_navigation_page.share: Layout/localization and seeded share security read; missing create-review-revoke-expire journey.
coverage_by_navigation_page.leads: Follow-up/filter/pagination/partial-source failure tests exist with fixture WordPress enquiry source.
coverage_by_navigation_page.billing: Invoice edit/pay/idempotency/filter tests exist; renewal test asserts button presence, not completed renewal.
coverage_by_navigation_page.plans: Layout/localization only; missing create/edit/persistence/role rejection UX.
coverage_by_navigation_page.llm: Configuration in broad mocked console test and local writing protocol fixture; no paid upstream provider verification.
coverage_by_navigation_page.providers: Local configuration CRUD and mocked probe result; no external account lifecycle proof.
coverage_by_navigation_page.mcp: Configuration CRUD; remote discovery only opt-in E2E_REMOTE_MCP=1.
coverage_by_navigation_page.team: Admin CRUD/conflict/secret display and MFA login tests; missing non-admin personal-security journey.

validation_limits.limit: Real HTTP handler tests substitute WordPress publication transport; they do not demonstrate a deployed site publication/recovery journey.
DNS authority and observation are fixture functions; public propagation is unverified.
Production smoke reads login and public sites/auth boundaries only; it does not log in to validate authenticated operator UX.
Tests are standalone Node Playwright scripts, and the broad responsive sweep uses admin. File presence is not a passing execution result; this audit did not run them.

experience_priorities.direction: 建立明确的账户工作区和站点工作区，统一站点切换、面包屑和返回行为，保留未保存内容保护

experience_priorities.finding: 20 个页面仅靠折叠菜单查找，没有功能搜索
experience_priorities.direction: 添加按角色过滤的功能搜索，支持中英文名称和键盘操作

experience_priorities.finding: 共享列表有分页和搜索，但缺少可访问的列排序及可选页容量

experience_priorities.direction: 修正加载状态语义及折叠控件点击区域，复测键盘、浅深色与手机视图

delivery_sequence: 完成弹窗、空/错误状态、跨站点切换和角色路径的复现审查
修复已确认的个人安全入口、维护错误反馈、分享状态与权限问题

完整 E2E、可访问性、双语响应式回归，再经 CI/预生产部署
acceptance: 当前20个页面及新增个人设置入口都具备可发现、按角色授权的完整路径

已确认的问题修复后有针对性证据；发布包、CI、预生产及生产验证通过
